svg.title: More testosterone, more muscle, in healthy young men
svg.desc: Bhasin 2001: 61 healthy men aged 18-35 had their own testosterone switched off, then got 25, 50, 125, 300 or 600 mg testosterone enanthate a week for 20 weeks. Lowest blood levels averaged 253, 306, 542, 1,345 and 2,370 ng/dL. Lean mass rose 3.4 kg at 125 mg, 5.2 kg at 300 mg and 7.9 kg at 600 mg.

svg.text: Orange: above the 350-750 ng/dL that the TRAVERSE treatment trial aimed for. Mood, sexual function and PSA did not

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: change significantly at any dose; HDL (good) cholesterol fell and hemoglobin rose as levels went up.
